clue.text: Stop dome redesign to force a style incorporating classical features

indicators.note: to redesign is to rework, so the letters of stop and dome are rearranged

parts.note: RN, the Royal Navy, is a fighting force

explanation.surface: An architect insists a domed building be reworked to suit a fashionable classical look.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the long tail of the clue; 'redesign' gives POSTMODE, and RN is the Royal Navy, a standard crossword force.
explanation.definitionFit: Postmodern architecture is known for borrowing columns, pediments and other ornaments from classical buildings.

clue.text: Strike a questioning attitude

parts.note: the phrase reads as adopting a quizzical stance; the word wanted means both to strike an attitude and to put a question

explanation.definitionFit: To pose is both to adopt a posture for show and to raise a query, as in setting a problem.

clue.text: This European region lies around three quarters of Asia

indicators.note: around suggests the letters of lies are scattered about into a new order
three of the four letters of Asia are kept, dropping its first letter

explanation.surface: A geography note that a European region spreads around much of Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lies' looks like a verb in the surface but is anagram fodder ('around' gives SILE); 'three quarters of' keeps SIA, the last three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Silesia is a historical region of central Europe, now mostly in Poland with parts in Czechia and Germany.

clue.text: Business craft

parts.note: reads as a trade skill, but craft means vessels and business means commerce: ships used for trade

explanation.definitionFit: A merchant fleet is the body of commercial vessels carrying cargo, as opposed to a navy.

clue.text: Find dance to get vicar up

parts.note: a disco is a dance party

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for vicar is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is the title of a vicar

explanation.surface: Someone learns that a dance has been arranged to get the vicar on his feet.
explanation.definitionFit: To discover something is to come upon or learn of it, the same as finding it.

clue.text: Summarise right to put up rate

indicators.note: in a down clue, put up means the word for rate is written bottom to top

parts.note: pace is a rate of speed

explanation.surface: An instruction to summarise why one is right to raise a price.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' turns PACE into ECAP beneath R.
explanation.definitionFit: To recap is to go over the main points again briefly, a short form of recapitulate.

clue.text: Affirm a five-nil winning start

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
nil is zero, which looks like the letter O

indicators.note: start points to the opening letter of the word winning

explanation.surface: A football report claims a five-nil win gave the team a great beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: To avow is to declare openly and firmly, a solemn way of asserting.

clue.text: Leave after faulty rivet becomes source of imbalance

indicators.note: after places the word for leave behind the rearranged letters
a faulty item is broken, so the letters of rivet are rearranged

parts.note: to go is to leave

explanation.surface: An engineer warns that a defective rivet makes a structure wobble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leave' reads as a noun of permission but is the verb, GO; 'faulty' gives VERTI and 'after' sets GO behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: Vertigo is a dizzy spinning sensation that upsets one's balance, often brought on by heights.

clue.text: Making progress on the board takes a blow

definitions.text: Making progress on the board takes a blow

parts.words: Making progress on the board takes a blow
parts.note: reads as a setback in a board game or boardroom, but the board is a sailboard pushed along by wind

explanation.definitionFit: A sailboarder rides a board with a sail and needs wind to move across water.

clue.text: Fly upwards, crossing left of the sun

indicators.note: crossing means the word for fly upwards goes across and around the letter for left

parts.note: to soar is to fly high

explanation.surface: A bird flies high, passing left of the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Solar is the adjective relating to the sun, as in solar power.

clue.text: New car, and cash in alternative sweetener

indicators.note: new suggests the letters of car and cash are made into something fresh

explanation.surface: Buying a new car and banking money as a different kind of treat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' rearranges CAR and CASH into SACCHAR, and IN is added as it stands.
explanation.definitionFit: Saccharin is an artificial sweetener used instead of sugar.

clue.text: Throwing twigs for bats

parts.note: hurling is throwing
sticks are twigs

explanation.surface: Someone throws twigs at flying bats.
explanation.walkthrough: Hurling is an Irish field game played with broad wooden sticks.
explanation.definitionFit: The sticks used in hurling are bats for striking the ball.

clue.text: Train political organisations for extra curricular socialising

parts.note: to school is to train or teach
parties are political organisations

explanation.surface: Activists coach political groups in after-hours mixing.
explanation.definitionFit: Groups of pupils on outings or celebrations enjoy social time outside lessons.

clue.text: Old medium-wave broadcast during asteroid storm

indicators.note: during means the broadcast letters go inside the rearranged rock name
a storm throws things about, so the letters of asteroid are rearranged

parts.note: AM, amplitude modulation, is the wave used for medium-wave broadcasts

explanation.surface: A news item about an ancient broadcast picked up in a meteor shower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old medium' is the definition, radio as an outdated medium; 'storm' gives STERADIO and 'during' sets AM within it.
explanation.definitionFit: Steam radio is a jocular British term for old-fashioned sound broadcasting, seen as outdated beside television.

clue.text: Drops in test failure for scaled-down transport system

indicators.note: in places the word for drops inside the rearranged letters
a failure breaks down, so the letters of test are rearranged

parts.note: rain falls as drops

explanation.surface: Raindrops get into a test rig and make it fail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drops' reads as a verb but is the noun, rainfall; 'failure' gives TSET and 'in' places RAIN within it.
explanation.definitionFit: A model railway is a miniature railway system for hobbyists.

clue.text: Force of six thousand belonging to us

parts.note: VI is the Roman numeral for six
G, for grand, is slang for a thousand
our means belonging to us

explanation.surface: We are proud of our strong army of six thousand.
explanation.definitionFit: Vigour is energy and strength, physical or mental power.

clue.text: Father leads friend to understand pope's position

indicators.note: leads puts the word for father in front of the word for friend

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
a pal is a friend
to see is to understand

explanation.surface: A dad shows his mate how to grasp the pontiff's role.
explanation.definitionFit: The papal see is the bishopric of Rome, the pontiff's office and seat of authority.

clue.text: Going out of control into a pile-up

parts.note: a drift is a heap of snow or sand piled up by wind

explanation.surface: A car spins out of control and slams into a multi-vehicle crash.
explanation.definitionFit: Something adrift floats loose, unsteered and drifting.

clue.text: Train from Turin with Europeans breaking down

indicators.note: something breaking down falls apart, so the letters of Turin and the European pair are rearranged

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for European, twice for Europeans

explanation.surface: A railway story about a train from Turin full of Europeans breaking down.
explanation.walkthrough: Train here is a group of followers, not a railway train.
explanation.definitionFit: A retinue is a group of attendants accompanying an important person, like a royal train.

clue.text: A belting, cruel — but results can be felt

indicators.note: cruel treatment batters something, so the letters of a and belting are rearranged

explanation.surface: A harsh beating leaves effects that can be physically felt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cruel' rearranges A BELTING into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Tangible means perceptible by touch, solid enough to handle.

clue.text: One of those decorative handles put with broomsticks in production

definitions.text: One of those decorative handles put with broomsticks in production

parts.words: One of those decorative handles put with broomsticks in production
parts.note: points to the Disney film whose title pairs these bed fittings with broomsticks

explanation.walkthrough: The film is the 1971 Disney musical whose title joins this object with broomsticks.
explanation.definitionFit: A bed finial is an ornamental knob on a bedstead post.

clue.text: The rate rodent reproduces is unpleasant to the core

indicators.note: reproduces suggests a new copy formed from the letters of the rate rodent

explanation.surface: A remark that rats breed at a nasty pace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reproduces' rearranges THE RATE RODENT into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone rotten-hearted is wicked deep down, corrupt at heart.

clue.text: They hide the head gangsters

explanation.definitionFit: Hoods are coverings that conceal the head; hoods is also slang for hoodlums, violent criminals.

clue.text: Depend on heartless lady

parts.note: re means on or concerning, as in business letters

indicators.note: heartless removes the middle of lady, leaving its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Someone relies on an unfeeling woman.
explanation.definitionFit: To rely is to trust and count upon someone or something.

clue.text: Gifts from party to some groups of people

parts.note: a do is a party
nations are groups of people

explanation.surface: Presents from a party to various communities.
explanation.definitionFit: Donations are things given, usually to charity.

clue.text: Once a flourishing craft

indicators.note: flourishing suggests a waving flourish that throws the letters of once and a about

explanation.surface: A trade that once thrived and has since declined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flourishing' rearranges ONCE A into the answer; craft is a boat, not a skill.
explanation.definitionFit: A canoe is a small light boat paddled by hand.

clue.text: Sign in bathroom — "engaged"

indicators.note: in tells us the answer sits inside the words bathroom and engaged

explanation.surface: A notice on a bathroom door saying it is occupied.
explanation.definitionFit: An omen is a portent or indication of what is to come.

clue.text: Seemingly nothing reasonably worn by model

parts.note: nothing is zero, shaped like the letter O

indicators.note: worn by means the word for reasonably wraps around the letter for model

parts.note: sensibly means reasonably
the Model T was an early Ford car, so T stands for model

explanation.surface: A fashion model seems to wear nothing very sensible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worn by' puts T inside SENSIBLY after its S, with O in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Ostensibly means apparently, as things are presented on the surface.
